topSignals.title: New — Germany's KWK-Gesetz (CHP law) gets a cabinet date: October 14.
topSignals.text: The Federal Economics Ministry has scheduled the combined heat-and-power legislation for cabinet consideration on Oct 14, with framework principles already released and stakeholder consultations underway. This is a separate legislative track from the EEG-Novelle/Netzpaket (see Regulations below) and is directly relevant to any SOFC-CHP or heat-recovery revenue-stacking case in the German model, since KWK-Gesetz support mechanisms set the subsidy/remuneration terms for combined-cycle or waste-heat-utilizing generation, including fuel cells. zfk.de Energiegesetze-Ticker

topSignals.title: PJM's 6 GW data-center-targeted capacity backstop auction opens tomorrow, Sept 30.
topSignals.text: The FERC-approved backstop mechanism — widely read as advantaging fast-deploy, grid-independent generation (batteries seen as having a competitive edge per trade press) over long-lead assets — runs its bidding window Sept 30-Oct 21. This is the first live test of the mechanism and is directly relevant to how on-site/behind-the-meter SOFC generation is valued relative to grid-connected alternatives in PJM territory. Energy-Storage.News
